_doc: Project pillars with skill sets for the directed autonomous tester. Each pillar has skills (specific analysis techniques), deep guidance, and guardrails. The 'autopilot' pillar runs when no specific focus is set — continuous broad improvement.

autopilot._doc: Autopilot runs at 50% weight when no pillar is PRIMARY. It rotates through all pillars randomly, focusing on non-structural improvements: bug hunting, consistency, minor quality fixes, documentation gaps. Safe by design — never touches architecture, never makes breaking changes.
skills: bug-hunter: scan for common JS bugs (null refs, async/await mistakes, unhandled promises, off-by-one, type coercion traps)
consistency-checker: find inconsistencies across files (naming conventions, error message format, log format, import style)
dead-code-finder: identify unused functions, unreachable branches, stale TODO comments, orphaned files
edge-case-explorer: generate edge case inputs the classifier/optimizer might not handle (empty strings, unicode, very long prompts, special chars)
quality-polish: improve error messages, add missing input validation at system boundaries, standardize return types
metric-generator: generate diverse realistic prompts to build datalake volume and improve statistical significance of A/B tests
guardrails: NEVER suggest changes to architecture or file structure
NEVER suggest changes to CLAUDE.md doctrine
NEVER suggest changes to .env or credentials
ONLY suggest improvements that are safe to apply without human review for structural decisions
ALL suggestions must be tagged with pillar, severity (low/medium), and estimated effort
